description: The grids the map shows for everyone: GA's national gravity, magnetics (TMI, RTP, 1VD...), radiometrics, isostatic residuals, SGTool products and DEM, and GSWA's WA Moho and scanned geological map mosaics. Returns each grid's raster_id, family, name, title, bounds and colour stretch. Read values with sample_raster or describe_raster and the raster_id.

q.description: Words in the title, name or family (e.g. "moho", "rtp"); empty lists all.
